claim_selection.method: Use exactly decision.correction_claim_ids from each bound CONTENT_CHANGE_DECISION.json.

operations.applies_when: Claim status is CONTRADICTED_BY_RECURSIVE_BYTE_AUDIT or the bound internal hash audit marks the assertion mismatched.
operations.effect: Generate a new versioned manifest from exact candidate bytes; retain old hash values only in provenance; never alter historical public bytes.

operations.applies_when: Claim is an unbound PASS, FINAL_PASS, EFFECT_ACK_DONE, P_nash, persistence, completion or universality assertion.
operations.effect: Replace the positive assertion in the versioned candidate with a bounded NOT_REVALIDATED statement and explicit false completion/publication fields.
